# Data Source name_services_name_mappings

Retrieves name mappings for a SVM.

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver name-mapping show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.9 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
# retrieving all name mappings for a SVM
data "netapp-ontap_name_services_name_mappings" "all_name_mappings" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster"
  filter = {
    svm_name = "svm1"
  }
}

# retrieving name mappings for a SVM and direction
data "netapp-ontap_name_services_name_mappings" "filtered_name_mappings" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster"
  filter = {
    svm_name = "svm1"
    direction = "unix_win"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `name_services_name_mappings` (Attributes List) List of name mappings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_services_name_mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) Direction of the name mappings. Possible values: krb_unix, win_unix, unix_win, s3_unix, s3_win.
- `svm_name` (String) Name of the SVM that owns the name mappings


<a id="nestedatt--name_services_name_mappings"></a>

### Nested Schema for `name_services_name_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `client_match` (String) Client workstation IP address or hostname matched when searching for the pattern
- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `direction` (String) Direction of the name mapping
- `id` (String) Composite identifier: {svm_uuid}/{direction}/{index}
- `index` (Number) Position in the list of name mappings
- `pattern` (String) UNIX-style regular expression used to match the name to be mapped
- `replacement` (String) Replacement name used when the pattern matches
- `svm_name` (String) Name of the SVM that owns the name mapping
